requirements.title: Health check registration
requirements.description: registerCheck(check) adds a health check to the registry

requirements.title: Platform-filtered check retrieval
requirements.description: getChecksForPlatform(platform) returns only checks valid for the current platform

requirements.title: Health check interface compliance
requirements.description: All checks implement id, description, intervalSeconds, platforms?, and run() method

requirements.title: Health result structure
requirements.description: All checks return {status: ok|warning|critical, message, details?}

requirements.title: Per-check interval tracking
requirements.description: Registry tracks last run time per check and only runs when interval elapsed

requirements.title: Configurable check intervals
requirements.description: Each check can specify its own intervalSeconds value

requirements.title: Registry registration and lookup
requirements.description: The check registry shall register, look up, and unregister checks by id safely under concurrent access, and the default check set shall register through the bootstrap factory.

requirements.title: Registry runs every due check
requirements.description: When RunAll is invoked, the registry shall execute every registered check that is due and shall serve results concurrently with a run in progress.

requirements.title: Platform and interval filtering
requirements.description: The registry shall skip checks whose platform filter excludes the current platform and checks whose interval has not elapsed since their last run.

requirements.title: Config provider gates checks and auto-heal
requirements.description: Where a configuration provider is set, the registry shall consult it to decide which checks run and which checks may auto-heal, and shall skip auto-heal for a check the provider disables.

validation.notes: Registered because api/internal/checks/registry.go (edited by the boot-recovery plan) cites it.

requirements.title: Auto-heal runs only safe recovery actions for critical checks
requirements.description: When auto-heal runs, the registry shall act only on healable checks in critical state, shall refuse actions marked dangerous, shall persist heal-tracker state through the configured store, and checks shall expose their recovery actions through RecoveryActions.

requirements.title: Testing seams for external dependencies
requirements.description: The API shall construct checks through a CheckFactory and run commands through an Executor interface, so check registration and command-driven checks can be tested with fakes instead of the host.
